example_uz: O‘sha yovvoyi rezavorlarni yeganidan keyin terisida og‘riqli qizil toshma paydo bo‘ldi.

definition_en: The complete feeling that there is no hope at all.
example_en: He looked at the ruins of his house in total despair.
example_uz: U uyining vayronalariga qarar ekan, mutlaqo umidsizlikka tushdi.

definition_en: Deserving respect and behaving in a way that is morally right.
example_en: It is an honorable duty to serve your country with complete integrity.
example_uz: O‘z vataniga halol xizmat qilish sharafli burchdir.

definition_en: Reflecting a lot of light and appearing smooth or bright.
example_en: The little boy found a shiny coin on the dirty street.
example_uz: Kichkina bola iflos ko‘chadan yaltiroq tanga topib oldi.

definition_en: A state of extreme pain, worry, sadness, or danger.
example_en: The loud cry for help indicated that the sailor was in distress.
example_uz: Baland ovozda yordam so‘rash dengizchining xavf ostida qolganidan dalolat berardi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to turn animal skins into leather.
example_en: The local tanner used natural ingredients to process the animal hides.
example_uz: Mahalliy charmgar hayvon terilarini ishlash uchun tabiiy vositalardan foydalangan.

definition_en: A message sent over long distances using an electrical telegraph system.
example_en: My grandfather received a telegram announcing the birth of his first child.
example_uz: Bobom birinchi farzandi tug'ilgani haqida telegramma olgan edi.

definition_en: An exclamation of great joy, happiness, or praise to God.
example_en: Hallelujah! It is finally the weekend and we can rest now.
example_uz: Hallelujah! Nihoyat hafta oxiri bo'ldi va biz dam olishimiz mumkin.

definition_en: An informal way of saying hello to someone.
example_en: Howdy folks, and welcome to our ninth annual summer party today!
example_uz: Hammaga salom, to'qqizinchi yillik yozgi bayramimizga xush kelibsiz!

definition_en: A person who performs tricks to entertain people by making things appear or disappear.
example_en: The magician pulled a white rabbit out of his empty hat.
example_uz: Sehrgar bo'sh shlyapasidan oq quyon chiqarib ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: A powerful explosive substance used for breaking rocks in mining and construction.
example_en: The workers used dynamite to blast through the hard rock tunnel.
example_uz: Ishchilar qattiq qoyani yorib o'tish uchun dinamitdan foydalanishdi.

definition_en: Not friendly or enjoyable; causing feelings of dislike.
example_en: It was an unpleasant experience to walk home in the heavy rain.
example_uz: Qattiq yomg'irda uyga piyoda qaytish juda yoqimsiz bo'ldi.

definition_en: A feeling of being unhappy because you want what someone else has.
example_en: He looked at his brother's new car with a feeling of jealousy.
example_uz: U akasining yangi mashinasiga hasad bilan qaradi.

definition_en: A soft, sweet dessert often served after a main meal.
example_en: For dinner tonight we are having a delicious chocolate pudding.
example_uz: Bugun kechki ovqatga mazali shokoladli puding yeymiz.

definition_en: The feeling of being unhappy or sorrowful.
example_en: She could not hide the deep sadness in her eyes today.
example_uz: U bugun ko'zlaridagi chuqur qayg'uni yashira olmadi.

definition_en: A dishonest or immoral person who treats other people badly.
example_en: That scoundrel cheated all his neighbors out of their hard-earned money.
example_uz: O'sha yaramas barcha qo'shnilarining halol pulini aldab olib qo'ydi.

definition_en: Showing good judgment and being practical.
example_en: It would be sensible to take an umbrella before you leave home.
example_uz: Uydan chiqishdan oldin soyabon olish oqilona ish bo'lardi.

definition_en: To pull something heavy along the ground with effort.
example_en: The boy was dragging his heavy school bag along the hallway floor.
example_uz: Bola og'ir maktab sumkasini koridor polida sudrab ketayotgan edi.

definition_en: To give money or gifts to someone to make them act in a dishonest way.
example_en: The businessman tried to bribe the official to win the big contract.
example_uz: Tadbirkor katta shartnomani yutib olish uchun amaldorga pora bermoqchi bo'ldi.

definition_en: The act of asking someone a lot of questions in a serious or formal way.
example_en: The suspect remained silent throughout the long police interrogation yesterday.
example_uz: Gumonlanuvchi kecha politsiyaning uzoq davom etgan so'rog'ida sukut saqladi.

definition_en: The act of shortening hair or the specific style in which hair is cut.
example_en: You look very different after getting a new haircut this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab soch oldirganingizdan keyin juda o'zgarib ketibsiz.

definition_en: For a short period of time.
example_en: Could you please stay and help me with this project awhile?
example_uz: Iltimos, ozgina qolib, menga shu loyihada yordam bera olasizmi?

definition_en: Done in a way that is planned and not by accident.
example_en: He deliberately left the door open so the cat could get out.
example_uz: U mushuk chiqib ketsin deb eshikni atayin ochiq qoldirdi.

definition_en: To feel very hungry because you have not had enough food.
example_en: I missed breakfast this morning and I am absolutely starving now.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab nonushta qilmagan edim, hozir juda och qoldim.

definition_en: A person who acts in a wild or very dangerous way.
example_en: That guy drives like a total maniac on these narrow city streets.
example_uz: U odam shaharning tor ko'chalarida xuddi jinnivoydek mashina haydaydi.

definition_en: A thin tube made of plastic or paper used for drinking liquids.
example_en: Could I please have an extra straw for my iced coffee?
example_uz: Muzli qahvam uchun yana bitta naycha bersangiz bo'ladimi?

definition_en: To say that someone has done something wrong or committed a crime.
example_en: They continue to accuse him of stealing money from the company.
example_uz: Ular uni kompaniya pullarini o'g'irlashda ayblashda davom etishyapti.

definition_en: A sticky substance used to join two things together firmly.
example_en: I used some strong glue to fix my broken plastic toy.
example_uz: Singan o'yinchoqlarimni tuzatish uchun kuchli yelimdan foydalandim.

definition_en: A man whose job is to sell products in a shop or business.
example_en: The car salesman explained all the features of the new model.
example_uz: Avtomobil sotuvchisi yangi modelning barcha qulayliklarini tushuntirib berdi.

definition_en: A person who is eating a meal, usually at a restaurant.
example_en: The waiter brought the menu to the diner sitting at the table.
example_uz: Ofitsiant stol o'rnida o'tirgan mijozga menyuni olib keldi.

definition_en: To measure how heavy a person or an object is.
example_en: You need to weigh the ingredients before you start baking the cake.
example_uz: Tort pishirishni boshlashdan oldin masalliqlarning og'irligini tortib olishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A sign or event that tells someone it is time to do something.
example_en: The music was the cue for the dancers to enter the stage.
example_uz: Musiqa raqqoslarning sahnaga chiqishi uchun ishora bo'ldi.

definition_en: A simple and quick drawing that does not show many details.
example_en: The architect made a quick sketch of the house design.
example_uz: Me'mor uy loyihasining tezkor eskizini chizdi.

definition_en: To look at something with great interest or admiration.
example_en: We stood on the mountain peak to behold the beautiful sunset.
example_uz: Biz go'zal quyosh botishini tomosha qilish uchun tog' cho'qqisida turdik.

definition_en: To ask for something in a very serious and emotional way.
example_en: The child began to plead with his mother for one more toy.
example_uz: Bola onasidan yana bitta o'yinchoq so'rab yolvora boshladi.

definition_en: An artificial covering of hair worn on the head for fashion or to hide baldness.
example_en: She decided to wear a blonde wig for the costume party tonight.
example_uz: U kostyumlar bazmi uchun sariq parik taqishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A hand-held tool with two sharp blades used for cutting paper, cloth, or hair.
example_en: Please hand me the scissors so I can cut this piece paper.
example_uz: Iltimos shu qog'ozni kesib olishim uchun qaychini uzatib yuboring.

definition_en: Relating to the processes that happen inside your brain or mind.
example_en: He prepared himself mentally for the difficult exam he had to take.
example_uz: U bo'lajak qiyin imtihonga o'zini xayolan tayyorlab qo'ydi.

definition_en: To run away from a place or situation of danger.
example_en: Many people had to flee their homes because of the terrible war.
example_uz: Ko'p odamlar dahshatli urush sababli o'z uylarini tashlab qochishga majbur bo'ldi.

definition_en: A member of a group of criminals who work together to commit crimes.
example_en: The famous gangster was finally caught by the police after many years.
example_uz: Mashhur jinoyatchi ko'p yillardan so'ng nihoyat politsiya tomonidan qo'lga olindi.

definition_en: Completely, totally, or considering everything that has happened or been said.
example_en: Altogether, it was a very successful meeting for the entire team today.
example_uz: Umuman olganda, bugungi yig'ilish butun jamoa uchun juda muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi.

definition_en: A flat case used for carrying business papers and documents.
example_en: He took his important documents out of his leather briefcase.
example_uz: U muhim hujjatlarini charm portfelidan chiqardi.

definition_en: An electrical device that makes a loud buzzing sound to give a signal.
example_en: If you think you know the answer, hit the buzzer quickly.
example_uz: Agar javobni bilsangiz, tezroq signal tugmasini bosing.

definition_en: The act of stopping an activity, habit, or leaving a job.
example_en: Quitting smoking is the best thing you can do for health.
example_uz: Chekishni tashlash sog‘lig‘ingiz uchun qila oladigan eng yaxshi narsadir.

definition_en: A small model of a person moved by strings or a hand.
example_en: The children laughed as the puppet danced on the stage.
example_uz: Bolalar qo‘g‘irchoq sahnada raqsga tushayotganda kulishdi.

definition_en: A thin, round, flat cake made from flour, milk, and eggs.
example_en: We usually eat hot pancakes with honey for our Sunday breakfast.
example_uz: Biz odatda yakshanba nonushtasiga asal bilan issiq blinchiklar yeymiz.

definition_en: A long narrow passage in a building with doors leading to rooms.
example_en: Our office is located at the end of the long corridor.
example_uz: Bizning ofisimiz uzun yo‘lakning oxirida joylashgan.

definition_en: To make someone feel ashamed, uncomfortable, or nervous in front of others.
example_en: His loud jokes in public often embarrassed his young daughter.
example_uz: Uning omma oldidagi baland ovozli hazillari qizini ko‘pincha uyaltirardi.

definition_en: The sharp, loud sound made by a dog when it is excited or angry.
example_en: The small dog barks loudly whenever someone walks past the front gate.
example_uz: Kichkina it darvozadan o'tayotgan odamlarga qarab baland ovozda huradi.

definition_en: A secret criminal organization involved in illegal activities like selling drugs or extortion.
example_en: The police are working hard to stop the local mafia from operating.
example_uz: Politsiya mahalliy jinoiy guruh faoliyatini to‘xtatish uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.

definition_en: A friendly or informal way to address a child or a younger friend.
example_en: Don't worry about it, kiddo, everything is going to be just fine.
example_uz: Xavotir olma, bolakay, hammasi yaxshi bo‘ladi.

definition_en: The rhythmic contraction and expansion of the heart that pumps blood through the body.
example_en: If your heartbeat does not normalize soon, you should consult a doctor.
example_uz: Agar yurak urishingiz tez orada me'yorga kelmasa, shifokorga murojaat qilishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A tube of rolled tobacco leaves that is lit at one end and smoked.
example_en: He sat back in his chair and enjoyed smoking a premium cigar.
example_uz: U stuliga o‘tirib, sifatli sigara chekishdan huzurlandi.

definition_en: A food made from dough that is shaped into long, thin strips and boiled.
example_en: We had a delicious bowl of hot chicken noodles for dinner tonight.
example_uz: Bugun kechki ovqatga mazali tovuqli ugra sho‘rva ichdik.

definition_en: To voluntarily leave a job or position permanently.
example_en: The manager decided to resign after working there for twenty years.
example_uz: Menejer yigirma yil ishlaganidan so'ng iste'fo berishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To take hold of something suddenly, by force or quickly.
example_en: You should seize every opportunity to practice your English skills daily.
example_uz: Ingliz tili ko'nikmalaringizni har kuni mashq qilish uchun har qanday imkoniyatdan foydalanishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The colored circular part of the eye around the black pupil.
example_en: Her iris was a very bright shade of green and gold.
example_uz: Uning ko'zining kamalak pardasi yorqin yashil va tillarang tusda edi.

definition_en: A large bird with black feathers and a harsh croaking sound.
example_en: A black crow sat on the branch and looked at us.
example_uz: Qora qarg'a shoxga qo'nib bizga qarab turdi.

definition_en: To make something not bent, twisted, or curly anymore.
example_en: She stood up to straighten her clothes before the important meeting.
example_uz: U muhim majlisdan oldin kiyimlarini to'g'rilash uchun o'rnidan turdi.

definition_en: To cause sudden pain with a sharp point, like an insect.
example_en: Be careful not to let the bee sting you on the hand.
example_uz: Asalarini qo'lingdan chaqib olishiga yo'l qo'yma, ehtiyot bo'l.

definition_en: A public official who investigates the cause of death when it is sudden or unusual.
example_en: The coroner examined the body to determine why the man died suddenly.
example_uz: Sud tibbiyoti eksperti o'lim sababini aniqlash uchun murdani ko'zdan kechirdi.

definition_en: The space just below the roof of a house, often used to store old things.
example_en: We climbed into the dusty attic to look for our old family photos.
example_uz: Eski oilaviy rasmlarimizni izlash uchun chang bosgan chordoqqa chiqdik.

definition_en: Easily affected by emotions such as sadness, love, or nostalgia rather than by logic.
example_en: She keeps all her old letters because she is a very sentimental person.
example_uz: U juda ta'sirchan inson bo'lgani uchun barcha eski xatlarini saqlab qo'ygan.

definition_en: Federal law enforcement officers or agents representing the national government.
example_en: The feds arrived at the building to investigate the serious crime.
example_uz: Politsiya og'ir jinoyatni tergov qilish uchun binoga yetib keldi.

definition_en: An urgent or emotional request for help, mercy, or support.
example_en: The charity made a public plea for donations after the earthquake.
example_uz: Xayriya tashkiloti zilziladan so'ng yordam so'rab murojaat qildi.

definition_en: The act of harming someone because they did something bad to you.
example_en: He swore to take vengeance on those who betrayed his trust.
example_uz: U o'z ishonchini suiiste'mol qilganlardan qasos olishga qasam ichdi.

definition_en: Willing to use illegal or dishonest methods for personal gain or money.
example_en: The government here is corrupt, so we'll emigrate to escape them.
example_uz: Bu yerdagi hukumat korrupsiyalashgan, shuning uchun biz qochib ketamiz.

definition_en: The act of complaining in an annoying and high-pitched voice.
example_en: Stop your whining and get back to your work right now.
example_uz: Noliwni bas qilib, darhol ishingga qayt.

definition_en: Something or someone that lives forever and will never die.
example_en: Many ancient legends talk about people who are said to be immortal.
example_uz: Ko'plab qadimiy afsonalarda o'lmas odamlar haqida so'z boradi.

definition_en: Used to emphasize that someone has a very strong need for something.
example_en: I could desperately do with some cold coffee right now.
example_uz: Hozir menga juda ham sovuq qahva kerak bo'lib turibdi.

definition_en: A person who is addicted to drinking large amounts of alcohol.
example_en: He has been a recovering alcoholic for the last five years.
example_uz: U besh yildan beri ichkilikdan butunlay voz kechgan.

definition_en: A person who cannot stop doing something or using a harmful substance.
example_en: The drug addict finally decided to seek help for his serious problem.
example_uz: Giyohvand odam oxiri o'zining jiddiy muammosi uchun yordam so'rashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Very pleasant and causing a lot of happiness.
example_en: We had a delightful evening talking with our friends in the garden.
example_uz: Bog'da do'stlarimiz bilan suhbatlashib, juda yoqimli oqshom o'tkazdik.

definition_en: A small hook on a wall used for hanging clothes or bags.
example_en: Please hang your heavy winter coat on the wooden peg by door.
example_uz: Iltimos, qalin qishki paltongizni eshik yonidagi ilgakka ilib qo'ying.

definition_en: In a way that relates to your feelings and emotions.
example_en: He spoke emotionally about the time he spent living away from home.
example_uz: U uydan uzoqda yashagan davrlari haqida hissiyotga berilib gapirib berdi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to keep and check financial accounts.
example_en: The company hired an accountant to manage all of their yearly taxes.
example_uz: Kompaniya yillik soliqlarini boshqarish uchun hisobchi yolladi.

definition_en: Funny and entertaining; causing you to smile or laugh.
example_en: The children found the clown's performance to be extremely amusing and fun.
example_uz: Bolalar masxarabozning chiqishini juda qiziqarli va quvnoq deb bilishdi.

definition_en: Lacking knowledge or education about important things or a specific subject.
example_en: It is dangerous to remain ignorant about the laws of the country.
example_uz: Mamlakat qonunlari haqida bilimsiz qolish xavfli.

definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from sugar cane or molasses.
example_en: He mixed a little rum into the cocktail for better flavor.
example_uz: U ta'mini yaxshilash uchun kokteylga ozgina rom qo'shdi.

definition_en: A chair with wheels used by people who cannot walk to move around.
example_en: The building has a ramp specifically for people in a wheelchair.
example_uz: Binoda nogironlar aravachasidagi kishilar uchun maxsus yo'lak bor.

definition_en: Existing, happening, or used below the surface of the water.
example_en: Divers took photos of the beautiful underwater world in the ocean.
example_uz: G'avvoslar okeandagi go'zal suvosti dunyosini suratga olishdi.

definition_en: To speak very quietly so that other people cannot hear what you are saying.
example_en: She leaned over to whisper a secret in my ear during class.
example_uz: U dars paytida qulog'imga sirni pichirlab aytish uchun egildi.

definition_en: The smallest finger on your hand.
example_en: She wore a small silver ring on her pinky finger.
example_uz: U jimjir barmog'iga kichkina kumush uzuk taqib yurardi.

definition_en: Able or likely to cause a violent explosion.
example_en: The police found an explosive device hidden inside the old brown bag.
example_uz: Politsiya eski jigarrang sumka ichiga yashirilgan portlovchi moslamani topdi.

definition_en: A person who behaves badly or is dishonest for their own gain.
example_en: The rogue trader lost all the company's money in one bad deal.
example_uz: Firibgar savdogar kompaniyaning barcha pulini yomon bitim tufayli yo‘qotdi.

definition_en: A wooden or metal cover on the outside of a window.
example_en: We closed the wooden shutters to keep the storm wind out.
example_uz: Bo‘ronli shamolni ichkariga kiritmaslik uchun yog‘och panjurlarni yopib qo‘ydik.

definition_en: To remove something that has been written or recorded.
example_en: I need to erase these notes from the whiteboard after the meeting.
example_uz: Majlisdan keyin doskadagi bu yozuvlarni o‘chirib tashlashim kerak.

definition_en: To check something carefully to see if it is acceptable or safe.
example_en: The government will vet every candidate before offering them a job.
example_uz: Hukumat ish taklif qilishdan oldin har bir nomzodni sinchiklab tekshiradi.

definition_en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and two large claws, eaten as food.
example_en: We enjoyed a delicious dinner of fresh grilled lobster by the beach.
example_uz: Biz sohil bo'yida mazali panjarada pishirilgan omar bilan kechki ovqatlandik.

definition_en: Having a strong desire to succeed, achieve wealth, or gain high status.
example_en: She is an ambitious student who wants to become a successful doctor.
example_uz: U muvaffaqiyatli shifokor bo'lishni xohlaydigan intiluvchan talaba.

definition_en: The short, sharp, regular sound made by a clock as it works.
example_en: The steady tick of the clock provided a comforting background for the room.
example_uz: Soatning bir maromdagi chiqillashi xonaga osoyishtalik baxsh etardi.

definition_en: A person, team, or company that competes with others for the same goal.
example_en: Chris is my biggest rival in the local tennis tournament this year.
example_uz: Kris bu yilgi mahalliy tennis turnirida mening eng katta raqibimdir.

definition_en: A man who is engaged to be married to a specific woman.
example_en: She went to pick up her fiancé from the airport this evening.
example_uz: U kechqurun aeroportdan kuyovini kutib olish uchun ketdi.

definition_en: To walk slowly around an area without having a clear purpose or direction.
example_en: We decided to wander through the old town to see the sights.
example_uz: Biz diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'rish uchun eski shahar bo'ylab kezishga qaror qildik.

definition_en: A powerful person who controls others through ruthless actions and superior skill.
example_en: The manager acts like a little napoleon over his terrified employees.
example_uz: Menejer o'z qo'l ostidagi xodimlarga nisbatan shafqatsiz hukmdordek munosabatda bo'ladi.

definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from fermented grains like barley or rye.
example_en: He poured a glass of whisky to relax after his long day.
example_uz: U uzun ish kunidan so'ng dam olish uchun bir stakan viski quydi.

definition_en: Feeling ashamed and having lost your dignity in front of other people.
example_en: She felt deeply humiliated after her boss criticized her in public.
example_uz: Boshlig'i uni hamma oldida tanqid qilganidan keyin u o'zini juda qattiq xorlangandek his qildi.

definition_en: A woman who has promised to marry someone.
example_en: He went to pick up his fiancée from the train station yesterday.
example_uz: U kecha o'zining kelinini poyezd stansiyasidan kutib olgani bordi.

definition_en: A long, sharp sound similar to the sound a snake makes.
example_en: We heard a loud hissing coming from the leaking gas pipe.
example_uz: Biz gaz quvuridagi sizishdan kelayotgan baland vishillash ovozini eshitdik.

definition_en: The daughter of your son or daughter.
example_en: My granddaughter is coming to visit me for the summer holidays.
example_uz: Nevaram yozgi ta'til uchun meni ko'rgani kelyapti.

definition_en: To breathe in through the nose to smell something or because of a cold.
example_en: The dog was sniffing around the garden looking for a hidden bone.
example_uz: It keti yashiringan suyakni izlab bog' bo'ylab hidlab yuribdi.

definition_en: Feeling thankful because someone has helped you or done you a favor.
example_en: I am deeply obliged for your kind help with my difficult project.
example_uz: Qiyin ishimda ko'rsatgan yordamingiz uchun sizdan juda minnatdorman.

definition_en: To cook food slowly in liquid in a closed container.
example_en: You should stew the meat for two hours to make it tender.
example_uz: Go'sht yumshoq bo'lishi uchun uni ikki soat davomida dimlab pishiring.

definition_en: A woman who is a member of a religious group and lives simply.
example_en: The nun spent her whole life helping the poor in the city.
example_uz: Rohiba butun umrini shahardagi kambag'allarga yordam berish bilan o'tkazdi.

definition_en: To stop someone from concentrating on what they are doing.
example_en: Please do not talk to him because it will distract his focus.
example_uz: Iltimos, u bilan gaplashmang, chunki bu uning diqqatini chalg'itadi.

definition_en: Having a sharp or acidic taste, like that of a lemon or vinegar.
example_en: This milk tastes sour so we should probably throw it away now.
example_uz: Bu sutning ta'mi nordon, shuning uchun uni tashlab yuborganimiz ma'qul.

definition_en: A tiny burning piece of material that flies out from a fire or electrical contact.
example_en: The campfire sent a bright spark flying into the night sky.
example_uz: Gullxan o‘chog‘idan ko‘kka yorqin uchqunlar sochildi.

definition_en: Very strong, violent, or showing great energy and determination.
example_en: A fierce storm battered the coastline for several hours last night.
example_uz: Shiddatli bo‘ron tun bo‘yi qirg‘oqni larzaga keltirdi.

definition_en: A dishonest plan or illegal trick used to get money from people.
example_en: They realized the investment opportunity was just an online scam.
example_uz: Ular bu sarmoya imkoniyati shunchaki internetdagi firibgarlik ekanini tushunib yetdilar.

definition_en: Feeling annoyed or upset because you cannot do what you want to do.
example_en: She easily gets frustrated when it comes to learning complex math formulas.
example_uz: Murakkab matematik formulalarni o'rganishda uning tezda hafsalasi pir bo'ladi.

definition_en: Making you feel excited or nervous because you do not know what will happen.
example_en: The television movie was so suspenseful that I could not look away.
example_uz: Bu televizion film shunchalik hayajonli ediki, ko'z uzolmadim.

definition_en: To love someone very much and feel great respect for them.
example_en: It is obvious to everyone that he simply adores his younger sister.
example_uz: U o'zining singlisini juda yaxshi ko'rishi barchaga ayon.

definition_en: A specific area or part of a town, especially one with a specific purpose.
example_en: The shops in the pedestrian precinct are usually busy on Saturday afternoons.
example_uz: Piyodalar hududidagi do'konlar shanba tushdan keyin odatda gavjum bo'ladi.

definition_en: A piece of equipment used to heat food or to warm a room.
example_en: She placed the heavy pan on the stove to start cooking dinner.
example_uz: U kechki ovqatni pishirish uchun og'ir tovani plita ustiga qo'ydi.

definition_en: To pull or carry something that is very heavy or difficult to move.
example_en: The truck was used to haul heavy logs from the deep forest.
example_uz: Yuk mashinasi o‘rmondan og‘ir o‘tinlarni tashish uchun ishlatildi.

definition_en: A place where children without parents live and are cared for by others.
example_en: She decided to donate all her extra clothes to the local orphanage.
example_uz: U o‘zining ortiqcha kiyimlarini mahalliy mehribonlik uyiga topshirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A signature of a famous person, usually signed for a fan.
example_en: The fans waited outside for hours just to get an autograph.
example_uz: Muxlislar shunchaki dastxat olish uchun tashqarida soatlab kutishdi.

definition_en: In a way that is sudden, very noticeable, or done with force.
example_en: Prices have risen sharply since the start of the new year.
example_uz: Yil boshidan beri narxlar keskin oshib ketdi.

definition_en: Medicine or drugs used to treat an illness or health condition.
example_en: You should take your meds on time to feel better every day.
example_uz: Tuzalib ketishing uchun dori-darmoningni o‘z vaqtida ichishing kerak.

definition_en: To buy clothing online and return it after wearing it once.
example_en: It is not fair to wardrobe clothes just for a single party.
example_uz: Faqat bir marta kiyib ko‘rish uchun kiyim buyurtma qilib, keyin uni qaytarish to‘g‘ri emas.

definition_en: Behaving as if sexually attracted to someone in a playful or light way.
example_en: He spent the whole evening flirting with the girl at the bar.
example_uz: U kechqurun bar boshida qiz bilan nozlanib o'tirdi.

definition_en: A small toy in the shape of a person, often used by young children.
example_en: The little girl hugged her dolly tight before going to sleep.
example_uz: Qizaloq uxlashdan oldin qo'g'irchog'ini mahkam quchoqlab oldi.

definition_en: A small amount of something that fits in the palm of your hand.
example_en: She gave me a handful of nuts to eat while walking home.
example_uz: U uyga qaytayotganimda yeyishim uchun bir hovuch yong'oq berdi.

definition_en: A large, round, orange vegetable that is commonly used to make soup or pies.
example_en: We made a delicious warm pumpkin soup for our dinner last night.
example_uz: Kecha kechki ovqatga mazali issiq qovoq sho'rva tayyorladik.

definition_en: Feeling pleased and happy about something good that has happened to you.
example_en: I am truly thankful for all your help during these hard times.
example_uz: Bu qiyin kunlarda yordamingiz uchun chin dildan minnatdorman.

definition_en: A feeling of sadness for the suffering of others and a desire to help them.
example_en: She showed great compassion for the victims of the natural disaster.
example_uz: U tabiiy ofat qurbonlariga katta hamdardlik bildirdi.

definition_en: The tubes in your body that carry blood toward the heart.
example_en: The doctor injected the medicine directly into his veins.
example_uz: Shifokor dori vositasini to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri uning qon tomiriga yubordi.

definition_en: An extreme interest in something that you cannot stop thinking about.
example_en: Collecting rare stamps has become an obsession for him recently.
example_uz: Nodir markalarni yig‘ish oxirgi paytlarda u uchun haqiqiy ishtiyoqqa aylandi.

definition_en: A tool with a long handle and a sharp metal blade for chopping wood.
example_en: He used a sharp axe to chop the logs for the fireplace.
example_uz: U kamin uchun o‘tinni o‘tkir bolta bilan yordi.

definition_en: Doing something dangerous without caring about the bad results that might happen.
example_en: His reckless driving caused a serious accident on the highway today.
example_uz: Uning ehtiyotsiz haydashi bugun magistral yo‘lda jiddiy avariyaga sabab bo‘ldi.

definition_en: A tool with a very sharp blade used for removing hair from the skin.
example_en: He uses a sharp razor to shave his beard every morning.
example_uz: U har kuni ertalab soqolini olish uchun o‘tkir ustara ishlatadi.

definition_en: Something that makes you feel very afraid or worried.
example_en: It was a frightening experience to be lost in the dark forest.
example_uz: Qorong‘u o‘rmonda adashib qolish juda qo‘rqinchli tajriba edi.

definition_en: An animal or plant that is different from its parents because of a genetic change.
example_en: The scientists studied the mutant DNA to understand how the disease develops.
example_uz: Olimlar kasallik qanday rivojlanishini tushunish uchun mutant DNKni o'rganishdi.

definition_en: A person who behaves in a silly, stupid or awkward way.
example_en: Don't be such a wally and just follow the instructions on screen.
example_uz: Ahmoqlik qilma va shunchaki ekrandagi ko'rsatmalarga amal qil.

definition_en: Extremely pleasant, beautiful, or enjoyable.
example_en: We spent a heavenly afternoon relaxing on the quiet sandy beach.
example_uz: Biz tinch qumli sohil bo'yida jannatiy bir kunni o'tkazdik.

definition_en: A word used to show mild annoyance or anger, softer than saying damn.
example_en: Dang, I forgot my keys inside the locked house again!
example_uz: La'nati, kalitlarimni yana qulflangan uy ichida unutibman!

definition_en: A young unmarried woman, often used in older stories or literature.
example_en: The brave knight saved the fair maiden from the dark forest.
example_uz: Jasur ritsar go'zal qizni qorong'u o'rmondan qutqarib oldi.

definition_en: To make the loud, short sound that a dog makes.
example_en: The neighbor's dog began to bark loudly when I arrived home.
example_uz: Uyga kelganimda qo'shnining iti qattiq vovullay boshladi.

definition_en: A male member of the United States House of Representatives.
example_en: The local congressman voted for the new tax reform bill yesterday.
example_uz: Mahalliy kongressmen kecha yangi soliq islohoti qonun loyihasi uchun ovoz berdi.

definition_en: A common gray or white bird often seen in city streets and parks.
example_en: The pigeon flew down to the ground to eat some bread crumbs.
example_uz: Kabutar non ushoqlarini yeyish uchun yerga qo‘ndi.

definition_en: Good enough to be admired and approved of by other people.
example_en: He has a respectable job and is known for being very honest.
example_uz: U hurmatga loyiq ishda ishlaydi va juda halol inson sifatida tanilgan.

definition_en: A playful trick or joke that is intended to surprise or tease someone.
example_en: The children thought it was a funny prank to hide my shoes.
example_uz: Bolalar poyafzalimni yashirib qo‘yishni qiziqarli hazil deb o‘ylashdi.

definition_en: The crime of betraying one's country or government.
example_en: The soldier was accused of treason for giving secrets to the enemy.
example_uz: Askarda dushmanga sirlarni oshkor qilganlikda ayblanib vatanga xiyonatda ayblov qo‘yildi.

definition_en: To move a spoon or stick around in a liquid to mix it.
example_en: You need to stir the soup slowly so it does not burn.
example_uz: Sho‘rvani kuymasin deb sekin-asta aralashtirib turishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A word used by adults to address or refer to a young girl.
example_en: That is enough talking back from you, missy!
example_uz: Gap qaytarganing yetadi, qizaloq!

definition_en: A Spanish title for a man that is equal to the English word Mr.
example_en: The shop owner, Señor Garcia, greeted us with a warm smile today.
example_uz: Do‘kon egasi janob Garsiya bizni bugun samimiy tabassum bilan kutib oldi.

definition_en: A large saltwater fish that is often eaten as food.
example_en: I usually make a quick sandwich with canned tuna for my lunch.
example_uz: Men odatda tushlik uchun konservalangan tunetsdan tez tayyorlanadigan sendvich qilaman.

definition_en: To push or fold the edge of something into a safe or tidy place.
example_en: Make sure you tuck your shirt into your trousers before the meeting.
example_uz: Majlisdan oldin ko‘ylagingizni shimingizning ichiga solib qo‘ying.

definition_en: The solid waste matter that leaves the body through the bowels.
example_en: The dog left some poop on the grass in the park today.
example_uz: Bugun it bog‘dagi maysazorga axlat qoldirib ketdi.

definition_en: Of the greatest importance; fundamental or main.
example_en: Respecting other people's privacy is a cardinal rule in our office.
example_uz: Boshqalarning shaxsiy hayotini hurmat qilish bizning ofisda asosiy qoida hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A flat table used for religious ceremonies or as a holy place.
example_en: The priest stood in front of the altar to lead the prayer.
example_uz: Ruhoniy ibodatni boshlash uchun qurbongoh oldida turdi.

definition_en: A soft sweet food made from fruit juice or gelatine that sets into a jelly.
example_en: His mother prepared jelly for him and his friends for dessert.
example_uz: Onasi unga va do'stlariga shirinlik uchun jele tayyorlab berdi.

definition_en: To cause someone to feel a sudden burst of excitement or pleasure.
example_en: The fast speed of the roller coaster will thrill the young riders.
example_uz: Attraksionning tezligi yosh chavandozlarni hayajonga soladi.

definition_en: A traditional wooden and earth house built by the Navajo people.
example_en: The family gathered inside their traditional hogan to share a warm meal.
example_uz: Oila issiq ovqatlanish uchun o'zlarining an'anaviy xoganlarida yig'ildi.

definition_en: To be unable to breathe because something is stuck in your throat.
example_en: Ever since he choked on a bone, he has refused to eat fish.
example_uz: U suyakka tiqilib qolganidan beri baliq yeyishdan voz kechdi.

definition_en: A person hired to protect someone from danger or attack.
example_en: The famous singer arrived at the concert surrounded by his bodyguard.
example_uz: Mashhur qo'shiqchi konsertga tansoqchisi hamrohligida yetib keldi.

definition_en: Either of the two bones in the mouth that hold the teeth.
example_en: His jaw dropped in amazement when he heard the shocking news.
example_uz: Shok xabarni eshitgach, uning hayratdan jag'i tushib qoldi.

definition_en: A light snack food made from corn kernels that pop when heated.
example_en: My friends and I ordered popcorn during the interval of the movie.
example_uz: Kino tanaffusida men va do'stlarim popkorn buyurtma qildik.

definition_en: The official room where a judge holds a trial to make legal decisions.
example_en: Everyone stood up silently as the judge entered the large crowded courtroom.
example_uz: Sudya sud zaliga kirib kelganida hamma jim bo‘lib o‘rnidan turdi.

definition_en: Having no purpose or meaning because it cannot achieve any good result.
example_en: Since the plan already failed, further discussion seems completely pointless to me.
example_uz: Reja barbod bo‘lganidan keyin, bu haqda gaplashib o‘tirish mutlaqo ma'nosizdek tuyuladi.

definition_en: Very shocking and morally wrong, often making people feel very angry.
example_en: It is outrageous that they are charging double prices for basic food.
example_uz: Oddiy oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari uchun ikki barobar haq olishlari juda adolatsizlikdir.

definition_en: Behaving in a very polite, kind, and generous way to other people.
example_en: She was gracious enough to thank everyone for their help and support.
example_uz: U barchaga yordami va qo‘llab-quvvatlashi uchun minnatdorlik bildiradigan darajada xushmuomala edi.

definition_en: To kill animals, usually for the purpose of eating their meat.
example_en: The farmer had to slaughter a sheep for the wedding feast.
example_uz: To'y uchun fermer bitta qo'y so'yishga majbur bo'ldi.

definition_en: A sleeveless piece of clothing that you wear on the top half of your body.
example_en: He wore a smart blue vest over his white shirt for work.
example_uz: U ishga oq ko'ylagi ustidan ko'k nimcha kiyib bordi.

definition_en: A person whose job is repairing machines, especially the engines of cars.
example_en: The car broke down so I called a mechanic to fix it.
example_uz: Mashinam buzilib qoldi, shuning uchun uni tuzatishga mexanik chaqirdim.

definition_en: A word for a child's grandmother.
example_en: Every Sunday we go to visit my nana for afternoon tea.
example_uz: Har yakshanba biz buvimnikiga tushki choy ichgani boramiz.

definition_en: A leather seat placed on the back of a horse for a person to sit on.
example_en: He put the saddle on the horse before starting his long ride.
example_uz: U uzoq yo‘lga chiqishdan oldin otiga egar qo‘ydi.

definition_en: The ceremony of placing a dead body into the ground.
example_en: His whole family was present at his burial service last Sunday.
example_uz: O‘tgan yakshanba kuni uning dafn marosimida butun oilasi ishtirok etdi.

definition_en: The state of being kept in a place and not allowed to leave.
example_en: The police kept him in detention for further questioning about the crime.
example_uz: Politsiya uni jinoyat haqida so‘roq qilish uchun hibsda ushlab turdi.

definition_en: To make a serious promise to do something important or behave in a certain way.
example_en: The rebels vowed to continue their fight until they won the war.
example_uz: Isyonchilar urushda g‘alaba qozonmaguncha kurashni davom ettirishga qasam ichdilar.

definition_en: To cook food using dry heat in an oven.
example_en: I decided to bake a delicious cherry pie for my family today.
example_uz: Men bugun oilam uchun mazali gilosli pirog pishirishga qaror qildim.

definition_en: In a gentle way or without using much force or effort.
example_en: She touched his arm lightly to get his attention in the crowd.
example_uz: U olomon ichida diqqatini tortish uchun uning yelkasiga yengil tegdi.

definition_en: A long, elegant dress or an official robe worn for special ceremonies.
example_en: She wore a beautiful long gown to the graduation ceremony last night.
example_uz: U kecha bitiruv marosimiga chiroyli uzun ko‘ylak kiyib bordi.

definition_en: Land that is far away from large cities where there are fields and few houses.
example_en: They decided to spend their summer holiday in the quiet English countryside.
example_uz: Ular yozgi ta'tilni sokin ingliz qishlog'ida o'tkazishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: Able to cause death or very serious harm to a living thing.
example_en: The snake has a lethal venom that can kill a man quickly.
example_uz: Bu ilonning zaxari o'ta halokatli bo'lib odamni tezda o'ldirishi mumkin.

definition_en: A large water bird with a long neck that is usually white.
example_en: We watched the beautiful swan swimming across the quiet lake this morning.
example_uz: Biz bugun ertalab ko'lda suzib yurgan go'zal oqqushni tomosha qildik.

definition_en: The soft light from the moon that appears during the night.
example_en: We took a romantic walk in the garden under the bright moonlight.
example_uz: Biz yorqin oy nuri ostida bog'da romantik sayr qildik.

definition_en: Spread out over a wide area rather than being together in one place.
example_en: There were scattered clouds in the sky throughout the entire sunny afternoon.
example_uz: Tushdan keyin quyoshli bo'lishiga qaramay osmonda tarqoq bulutlar bor edi.

definition_en: Armed people who steal from others, usually while traveling in a group.
example_en: The travelers were afraid of bandits hiding in the dark forest.
example_uz: Yo‘lovchilar qorong‘u o‘rmonda yashiringan qaroqchilardan qo‘rqishdi.

definition_en: The crispy, salty skin or fat left over after roasting pork.
example_en: The crackling on the roast pork was crunchy and very delicious.
example_uz: Qovurilgan cho‘chqa go‘shtining terisi juda qarsildoq va mazali edi.

definition_en: An unhappy feeling caused by being alone and having no friends or family.
example_en: She suffered from deep loneliness after moving to a new city.
example_uz: U yangi shaharga ko‘chib o‘tgach, qattiq yolg‘izlikni his qildi.

definition_en: In a way that shows you are happy and willing to do something.
example_en: If you need any help with your project, I will gladly assist.
example_uz: Agar loyihangizda yordam kerak bo‘lsa, jon deb yordam beraman.

definition_en: A mountain that can open and push out hot melted rock and gas from inside.
example_en: The island was created by the eruption of a massive active volcano.
example_uz: Bu orol ulkan faol vulqonning otilishi natijasida paydo bo‘lgan.

definition_en: A person who helps someone else to commit a crime.
example_en: The police caught the robber and his accomplice trying to flee town.
example_uz: Politsiya o‘g‘rini va uning sherigini shahardan qochmoqchi bo‘lganida qo‘lga oldi.

definition_en: A reward of money paid for catching or killing a wanted criminal.
example_en: The government offered a large bounty for information leading to his arrest.
example_uz: Hukumat uning hibsga olinishiga olib keladigan ma’lumot uchun katta mukofot e’lon qildi.

definition_en: Saying exactly what you think without trying to be polite or kind.
example_en: He gave a blunt answer because he did not want to waste time.
example_uz: U vaqtni yo‘qotmaslik uchun juda ochiq va keskin javob berdi.

definition_en: A fight or struggle between two people or groups to resolve a conflict.
example_en: The two politicians fought a bitter duel over the new economic policy.
example_uz: Ikkala siyosatchi yangi iqtisodiy siyosat bo‘yicha qattiq yakkakurash olib borishdi.

definition_en: An affectionate name for a grandmother or an elderly woman in some Eastern European cultures.
example_en: My dear baba always tells us interesting stories from her young life.
example_uz: Mehribon buvijonim har doim bizga yoshligi haqida qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib beradi.

definition_en: A pair of metal rings joined by a chain used to lock someone's hands together.
example_en: The police put handcuffs on the suspect before taking him away quickly.
example_uz: Politsiyachilar gumonlanuvchini olib ketishdan oldin unga kishan solishdi.

definition_en: Used to show that something is believed to be true based on claims or rumors.
example_en: The ancient treasure was supposedly hidden in this dark cave for centuries.
example_uz: Qadimiy xazina go‘yoki asrlar davomida shu qorong‘i g‘orda yashiringan.

definition_en: A bundle of wooden sticks or brushwood tied together for use as fuel.
example_en: He gathered a large faggot to keep the campfire burning all night.
example_uz: U gulxanni butun tun davomida yoqib turish uchun bir bog'lam o'tin yig'di.

definition_en: A feeling or idea that something is true without evidence.
example_en: I have a hunch that it will rain later this afternoon.
example_uz: Bugun tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'ishi haqida menda bir taxmin bor.

definition_en: To leave a dirty mark on something that is difficult to remove.
example_en: Be careful not to stain your shirt with that red wine.
example_uz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, qizil vino bilan ko'ylagingizga dog' tushirib qo'ymang.

definition_en: Showing kindness and thinking about what other people need or want.
example_en: It was very thoughtful of you to bring me some flowers.
example_uz: Menga gul olib kelganingiz juda e'tiborli ish bo'ldi.

definition_en: To provide fun or enjoyment for other people.
example_en: They hired a magician to entertain the children at the party.
example_uz: Ular ziyofatda bolalar ko'nglini ochish uchun sehrgar yollashdi.

definition_en: A surprise attack by people hiding and waiting for someone.
example_en: The soldiers were caught in an enemy ambush during the patrol.
example_uz: Patrul paytida askarlar dushman pistirmasiga tushib qolishdi.

definition_en: Behaving in a silly or immature way that is typical of a child.
example_en: Stop this childish behavior and try to act like an adult.
example_uz: Bu bolalarcha qiliqlarni yig'ishtirib, katta odamdek harakat qil.

definition_en: Not steady or firm; likely to change, fall, or fail suddenly.
example_en: The economic situation in the region remains very unstable right now.
example_uz: Mintaqadagi iqtisodiy vaziyat hozircha juda beqarorligicha qolmoqda.

definition_en: A person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a government official.
example_en: Many politicians promise to lower taxes during their election campaigns.
example_uz: Ko‘pgina siyosatchilar saylovoldi kampaniyasi davrida soliqlarni kamaytirishga va’da berishadi.

definition_en: Feeling or showing great surprise or wonder about something.
example_en: I was amazed at how quickly the children learned the song.
example_uz: Bolalar qo‘shiqni shunchalik tez o‘rganib olganidan hayron qoldim.

definition_en: A large, heavy, and old ship that is no longer used for sailing.
example_en: The old rusted hulk remained in the harbor for many years.
example_uz: Eski zanglagan kema ko‘p yillar davomida portda qolib ketdi.

definition_en: Being in a state where you have consumed too much alcohol.
example_en: The drunken man struggled to walk in a straight line home.
example_uz: Mast odam uyi tomon to‘g‘ri yura olmay qiynaldi.

definition_en: A stick that helps a person to walk more easily or steadily.
example_en: The elderly man used a wooden cane to help him walk today.
example_uz: Keksa odam yurishiga yordam berishi uchun yog‘och hassadan foydalandi.

definition_en: To harm someone because they have harmed you or someone you love.
example_en: He vowed to avenge the death of his loyal family members.
example_uz: U sadoqatli oila a'zolarining o‘limi uchun qasos olishga qasam ichdi.

definition_en: Relating to the right side of something.
example_en: In heraldry, the dexter side of the shield faces the viewer's left.
example_uz: Geraldikada qalqonning o‘ng tomoni tomoshabinning chap tomoniga qarab turadi.

definition_en: To comb hair upwards towards the roots to make it look thicker and fuller.
example_en: She likes to tease her hair to give it more volume.
example_uz: U sochiga hajm berish uchun uni tarashni yoqtiradi.

definition_en: To shut a door or window with a lot of force and loud noise.
example_en: Please do not slam the door when you leave the room.
example_uz: Xonadan chiqayotganingizda eshikni qarsillatib yopmang.

definition_en: Feeling extremely tired and exhausted after a long period of hard work.
example_en: I stayed up all night working and now I am completely shattered.
example_uz: Butun tun ishladim, endi esa judayam charchab qoldim.

definition_en: A very loud and unpleasant noise that makes it hard to hear anything else.
example_en: With all that racket outside I cannot hear myself think.
example_uz: Tashqaridagi shovqin sababli o'z xayollarimga ham jam bo'la olmayapman.

definition_en: Coming after seven other things in a series or order.
example_en: Today is the eighth day of our summer vacation together.
example_uz: Bugun birgalikdagi yozgi ta'tilimizning sakkizinchi kuni.

definition_en: A small bird with a strong beak that mostly eats seeds.
example_en: A small colorful finch landed on the branch near my window.
example_uz: Derazam yonidagi shoxga kichkina rang-barang chugurchuq qo‘ndi.

definition_en: A large group of soldiers that is part of an army.
example_en: The entire regiment marched across the field during the morning ceremony.
example_uz: Butun polk ertalabki marosim vaqtida maydon bo‘ylab saf tortib o‘tdi.

definition_en: A person's family or blood relatives.
example_en: He gathered all his kin for a large family celebration yesterday.
example_uz: U kecha katta oilaviy bayram uchun barcha qarindoshlarini yig‘di.

definition_en: To make someone feel suddenly scared or nervous.
example_en: The loud noise of the thunder began to frighten the children.
example_uz: Momaqaldiroqning baland ovozi bolalarni qo‘rqita boshladi.

definition_en: A type of long and thin pasta made from flour and water.
example_en: Her mother was cooking spaghetti for dinner in the kitchen.
example_uz: Onasi kechki ovqat uchun spagetti pishirayotgan edi.

definition_en: Making a loud, rough sound with teeth showing in an angry way.
example_en: The snarling dog scared me away without ever opening its mouth.
example_uz: Vovullagan it meni qo‘rqitib, yaqinlashtirmadi.

definition_en: A small, hot-tasting red or green pepper used to add flavor to food.
example_en: I added a little bit of fresh chili to my spicy soup.
example_uz: Sho‘rvamga ozgina yangi achchiq qalampir qo‘shdim.

definition_en: Taken away by force, usually to be held as a prisoner.
example_en: The famous scientist was abducted while walking home late at night.
example_uz: Mashhur olim kechasi uyiga qaytayotganida o‘g‘irlab ketildi.

definition_en: Feeling suddenly very afraid and unable to think clearly.
example_en: She felt panicked when she realized she had lost her passport.
example_uz: Pasportini yo‘qotib qo‘yganini bilib, vahimaga tushdi.

definition_en: Having only a small distance from the top to the bottom.
example_en: The water in this part of the lake is quite shallow indeed.
example_uz: Ko‘lning bu qismidagi suv ancha sayoz ekan.

definition_en: One of the soft, light parts that cover a bird's body.
example_en: I found a beautiful blue bird feather lying on the garden path.
example_uz: Bog‘ yo‘lagida yotgan chiroyli ko‘k qush patini topib oldim.

definition_en: To open a knot or loosen something that is tied with a string.
example_en: Can you help me untie these tight shoelaces before we go out?
example_uz: Ko‘chaga chiqishdan oldin bu mahkam bog‘langan bog‘ichlarni yechishga yordamlashib yuborasizmi?

definition_en: The illegal act of following or watching a person in a threatening way.
example_en: Stalking is a serious crime that causes victims to feel constant fear.
example_uz: Ta‘qib qilish – qurbonlarda doimiy qo‘rquv hissini uyg‘otadigan jiddiy jinoyatdir.

definition_en: Not real or honest, but made to appear as if it is true.
example_en: He gave me a phony excuse for why he was late today.
example_uz: U kechikkaniga soxta bahona aytdi.

definition_en: To hit something hard and with a loud sound.
example_en: The player had to whack the ball hard to score a goal.
example_uz: O'yinchi gol urish uchun to'pni qattiq tepishi kerak edi.

definition_en: A person who shoots at people from a hidden position far away.
example_en: The soldiers were warned about a hidden sniper in the area.
example_uz: Askarlarni hududdagi yashiringan mergan haqida ogohlantirishdi.

definition_en: The time of day just after the sun has gone down.
example_en: We enjoyed taking a long walk during the quiet summer twilight.
example_uz: Biz yozgi sokin shom qorong'usida uzoq sayr qilishdan zavqlandik.

definition_en: A man who promises to help raise a child during their religious initiation.
example_en: My godfather gave me a nice gift on my birthday every year.
example_uz: Cho'qintirgan otam har yili tug'ilgan kunimda menga chiroyli sovg'a berardi.

definition_en: A long, loose piece of clothing worn for comfort or official ceremonies.
example_en: She put on her warm robe after coming out of the shower.
example_uz: U dushdan chiqqach, issiq xalatini kiyib oldi.

definition_en: The part of the body between the hips and the stomach.
example_en: She wore a black belt around her slim waist to look stylish.
example_uz: U zamonaviy ko'rinish uchun ingichka beliga qora kamar taqib oldi.

definition_en: A feeling of sadness because something did not happen as you expected.
example_en: To my great disappointment, the concert was cancelled at the last minute.
example_uz: Hafsalalarim pir bo'lib, konsert oxirgi daqiqada bekor qilindi.

definition_en: A spicy South Asian dish served with rice or bread.
example_en: We often go to the local Indian restaurant to eat spicy curry.
example_uz: Biz ko'pincha achchiq karri yeyish uchun mahalliy hind restoraniga boramiz.

definition_en: Suggesting that something bad is likely to happen in the future.
example_en: There was an ominous silence before the storm began to hit hard.
example_uz: Bo'ron boshlanishidan oldin g'alati va xavfli sukunat hukm surdi.

definition_en: The light that comes from the sun during the day.
example_en: The bedroom was filled with warm sunlight throughout the entire morning.
example_uz: Yotoqxona ertalabdan kechgacha iliq quyosh nuri bilan to'lib turardi.

definition_en: People who are killed or injured in an accident or a war.
example_en: The government reported that there were no casualties after the big earthquake.
example_uz: Hukumat kuchli zilziladan so'ng qurbonlar bo'lmaganini xabar qildi.

definition_en: The front part of your leg between your knee and your ankle.
example_en: Soccer players wear pads to protect their shins from getting hurt.
example_uz: Futbolchilar boldirlarini shikastlanishdan himoya qilish uchun maxsus qalqon taqishadi.

definition_en: The yellow liquid waste that is produced by the kidneys and leaves the body.
example_en: The doctor asked the patient to provide a sample of their urine.
example_uz: Shifokor bemordan tahlil uchun siydik namunasini olib kelishni so‘radi.

definition_en: A person who is in charge of a group of workers at a site.
example_en: The foreman gave instructions to the team before starting the building work.
example_uz: Qurilish ishlari boshlanishidan oldin brigadir jamoaga kerakli ko‘rsatmalarni berdi.

definition_en: A period of time during which a person is being tested for a new job.
example_en: I will be on probation for three months before becoming a permanent employee.
example_uz: Doimiy xodim bo‘lishimdan oldin uch oy davomida sinov muddatida bo‘laman.

definition_en: To press a small amount of someone's skin tightly between your thumb and finger.
example_en: My little brother loves to pinch me when I am not looking.
example_uz: Ukajonim qaramay qolganimda meni chimchilab olishni yaxshi ko‘radi.

definition_en: Talking in a friendly and informal way with someone about daily things.
example_en: The two friends spent the whole afternoon chatting about their summer plans.
example_uz: Ikki do‘st butun tushdan keyin yozgi rejalari haqida suhbatlashib o‘tirdi.

definition_en: A person who robs others, usually as part of a group in a lawless area.
example_en: The mountain road was dangerous because of the local band of bandits.
example_uz: Tog' yo'li mahalliy qaroqchilar guruhi tufayli juda xavfli edi.

definition_en: Certain to happen or to end in a particular way because of fate.
example_en: She always felt that she was destined for a great acting career.
example_uz: U o'zini buyuk aktrisalik martabasi uchun yaratilgan deb hisoblar edi.

definition_en: A very long and expensive car, often with a driver.
example_en: The famous singer arrived at the hotel in a long black limo.
example_uz: Mashhur qo'shiqchi mehmonxonaga uzun qora limuzinda yetib keldi.

definition_en: Completely or entirely to the maximum degree.
example_en: When I realized I lost my passport, I felt utterly hopeless.
example_uz: Pasportimni yo'qotganimni anglaganimda, o'zimni mutlaqo ojiz his qildim.

definition_en: Happening in a way that is the opposite of what you expected to happen.
example_en: It is ironic that the firefighter's house burned down last night.
example_uz: O‘t o‘chiruvchining uyi yonib ketgani juda g‘alati va kutilmagan holat.

definition_en: The short, sharp sound made when something bursts or snaps open.
example_en: I heard the popping of balloons during the birthday party celebration.
example_uz: Tug‘ilgan kun bayramida sharlarning tarsillagan ovozini eshitdim.

definition_en: At a greater distance in physical space.
example_en: We decided to drive a little farther to reach the lake.
example_uz: Ko‘lga yetib olish uchun yana biroz uzoqroq haydashga qaror qildik.

definition_en: The person who is in charge of a ship or a sports team.
example_en: The team skipper led his players onto the field with confidence.
example_uz: Jamoa sardori o‘z o‘yinchilarini maydonga ishonch bilan boshlab chiqdi.

definition_en: Feeling very pleased and proud because someone said something kind about you.
example_en: I was flattered by your kind words about my new project.
example_uz: Yangi loyiham haqidagi iliq so‘zlaringiz meni juda mamnun qildi.

definition_en: A large round fruit with a hard brown shell and white flesh inside.
example_en: We drank fresh coconut water while sitting on the sunny beach.
example_uz: Quyoshli sohil bo‘yida o‘tirib, yangi kokos suvidan ichdik.

definition_en: A word shouted to express great joy or victory.
example_en: Hooray! We have finally finished all of our difficult exams today.
example_uz: Ura! Biz nihoyat bugun barcha qiyin imtihonlarimizni topshirib bo‘ldik.

definition_en: Good things that happen to you and make your life better.
example_en: We should always be thankful for the many blessings in our lives.
example_uz: Hayotimizdagi ko‘plab ne‘matlar uchun har doim shukr qilishimiz kerak.

definition_en: Having no purpose or importance; not having any clear meaning.
example_en: It is meaningless to argue about things that cannot be changed.
example_uz: Hech narsani o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan vaziyatda bahslashishning foydasi yo'q.

definition_en: To slowly become less bright, loud, or strong until disappearing.
example_en: The colors of the old photograph began to fade over time.
example_uz: Eski suratning ranglari vaqt o'tishi bilan xiralashib ketdi.

definition_en: Feeling very unhappy, sick, or having an extremely poor quality of life.
example_en: After the disaster, thousands of people lived in wretched conditions.
example_uz: Falokatdan so'ng minglab odamlar juda og'ir sharoitda yashashdi.

definition_en: The process of someone or something becoming impossible to see or find.
example_en: Wireless technology led to the disappearance of cords on old telephone handsets.
example_uz: Simsiz texnologiyalar eski telefonlarning simlari yo'qolib ketishiga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: A large shop where you pick your own food and household goods to buy.
example_en: I went to the local supermarket to buy some fresh food today.
example_uz: Men bugun yangi mahsulotlar xarid qilish uchun mahalliy supermarketga bordim.

definition_en: A long platform built from the shore over water for ships or walking.
example_en: Many people enjoy walking along the wooden pier during the summer evenings.
example_uz: Ko'plab odamlar yozgi oqshomlarda yog'och pristandan yurishni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

definition_en: The act of being disloyal to someone who trusts you.
example_en: His betrayal of his best friend left everyone feeling very shocked and sad.
example_uz: Uning o'z yaqin do'stiga qilgan xiyonati barchani hayratda qoldirdi va xafa qildi.

definition_en: A person who looks after something or someone and keeps them safe.
example_en: The lighthouse keeper ensured the light stayed on throughout the dark night.
example_uz: Mayoq qo'riqchisi tun davomida chiroq o'chmasligini nazorat qilib turdi.

definition_en: Unable to stay still or quiet because of worry or boredom.
example_en: The restless child could not sit still in the classroom today.
example_uz: Tinchsiz bola bugun sinfxonada jim o‘tira olmadi.

definition_en: Extremely good, pleasant, or causing great surprise and admiration.
example_en: We had a marvellous time at the beautiful beach last summer.
example_uz: O‘tgan yozda go‘zal sohilda ajoyib vaqt o‘tkazdik.

definition_en: A feeling of deep anger or dislike towards someone for a past action.
example_en: It is not healthy to hold a grudge against your old friends.
example_uz: Eski do‘stlaringizga nisbatan gina saqlash sog‘liq uchun foydali emas.

definition_en: A ship designed to operate completely underwater for long periods.
example_en: The navy submarine remained underwater during the entire training mission.
example_uz: Harbiy dengiz floti suvosti kemasi o‘quv mashg‘uloti davomida suv ostida qoldi.

definition_en: The smallest and least valuable chess piece that moves forward only.
example_en: He lost his pawn early in the game to his opponent.
example_uz: U o‘yin boshida raqibiga o‘z pishkasini boy berdi.

definition_en: A person who often tells jokes or tries to make people laugh.
example_en: He is a real joker and always makes us laugh at school.
example_uz: U juda hazilkash yigit va maktabda bizni doim kuldiradi.

definition_en: A word used when you have made a small or clumsy mistake.
example_en: Whoops, I accidentally dropped my glass of water on the floor.
example_uz: Voy, bilmay suv stakanimni yerga tushirib yubordim.

definition_en: A covered area just outside the front door of a house.
example_en: They sat on the porch and watched the rain fall outside.
example_uz: Ular ayvonda o‘tirib, yomg‘ir yog‘ayotganini tomosha qilishdi.

definition_en: To heat a liquid until it starts to bubble and turn into steam.
example_en: You need to boil some water to make a cup of tea.
example_uz: Choy damlash uchun bir oz suv qaynatishingiz kerak.

definition_en: To go down into a position where your knees are touching the floor.
example_en: You have to kneel down to look under the low bed.
example_uz: Past karavot tagini ko'rish uchun tizzalab o'tirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Moving or acting in a way that is not careful and often drops things.
example_en: He is very clumsy and often drops dishes in the kitchen.
example_uz: U juda eptishmas, oshxonada idishlarni tez-tez tushirib yuboradi.

definition_en: Things like bullets or shells that are fired from weapons in a war.
example_en: The soldiers ran out of ammunition during the long battle.
example_uz: Uzoq davom etgan jangda askarlarning o'q-dorisi tugab qoldi.

definition_en: A Japanese food made of small balls of rice with fish or vegetables.
example_en: He went to a Japanese restaurant and ordered sushi and noodles.
example_uz: U yapon restoraniga borib, sushi va lag'mon buyurtma qildi.

definition_en: A dealer who supplies specialized equipment or provisions, often for ships.
example_en: The ship chandler delivered fresh supplies before the vessel left the port.
example_uz: Kema portdan chiqib ketishidan oldin ta'minotchi yangi mahsulotlarni yetkazib berdi.

definition_en: To experience an abnormally slow heartbeat of under sixty beats per minute.
example_en: The patient began to brady during the intense monitoring of his heart.
example_uz: Yurak monitoringi davomida bemorning yurak urishi sekinlashib qoldi.

definition_en: An excessive and selfish desire for more money or possessions than you need.
example_en: His uncontrollable greed led him to make many dishonest business decisions.
example_uz: Uning nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan ochko'zligi ko'plab nohalol biznes qarorlariga olib keldi.

definition_en: Having bad luck or experiencing unpleasant things that are not your fault.
example_en: I was very unlucky to lose my passport on the first day.
example_uz: Pasportimni birinchi kuniyoq yo'qotib qo'yganim juda omadsiz holat bo'ldi.

definition_en: A long walk in the countryside, usually taken for pleasure or exercise.
example_en: We went on a long hike through the mountains last weekend.
example_uz: O'tgan dam olish kunlari tog'larda uzoq piyoda sayohat qildik.

definition_en: A short, sharp knife used as a weapon for stabbing.
example_en: The historical exhibit featured an ancient dagger with an ornate gold handle.
example_uz: Tarixiy ko'rgazmada oltin dasta bilan bezatilgan qadimiy xanjar namoyish etildi.

definition_en: An informal way to refer to food or a meal.
example_en: We stopped at a small diner to get some hot chow.
example_uz: Biz issiq ovqatlanib olish uchun kichik kafeda to'xtadik.

definition_en: The particular way a person forms letters when writing by hand.
example_en: It is difficult to read his handwriting because he writes so quickly.
example_uz: U juda tez yozgani uchun xatini o'qish qiyin.

definition_en: To laugh at someone or make fun of them in an unkind way.
example_en: It is not polite to mock people who are different from you.
example_uz: O‘zingdan farqli odamlarni masxara qilish odobdan emas.

definition_en: Covered with or consisting of many shells from sea creatures.
example_en: We spent the afternoon walking along the beautiful shelly beach.
example_uz: Biz tushdan keyin chiganoqqa to‘la go‘zal sohil bo‘ylab sayr qildik.

definition_en: To hit your hands together many times to show you liked a performance.
example_en: The audience started to clap loudly after the singer finished the song.
example_uz: Xonanda qo‘shiqni tugatgach, tomoshabinlar qarsak chalishni boshlashdi.

definition_en: Hair that grows on a man's upper lip.
example_en: He decided to grow a thick mustache for the winter season.
example_uz: U qish fasli uchun qalin mo‘ylov o‘stirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: An illegal act that is against the law.
example_en: Driving without a valid license is a serious traffic offence.
example_uz: Hujjatlarsiz haydash jiddiy yo‘l harakati qoidabuzarligi hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A king or ruler in some Muslim countries.
example_en: The sultan built a magnificent palace in the center of the city.
example_uz: Sulton shaharning markazida muhtasham saroy qurdirgan.

definition_en: A large, strong building or place used for protection against an enemy.
example_en: The old fortress stood on the hill, overlooking the entire valley.
example_uz: Qadimiy qal’a tepalikda joylashib, butun vodiyga nazar solib turardi.

definition_en: A small shop where you can buy coffee, drinks, and light meals to eat there.
example_en: We met at a local café to chat over a cup of coffee.
example_uz: Kofe ustida suhbatlashish uchun mahalliy kafeda uchrashdik.

definition_en: To remove the outer skin or covering from a fruit, vegetable, or other thing.
example_en: I helped my mother peel some fresh oranges for the fruit salad.
example_uz: Onamga mevali salat uchun yangi apelsinlarni archishga yordam berdim.

definition_en: A liquid made from oil that is used to provide power for car engines.
example_en: We stopped at the gas station to fill up with more petrol.
example_uz: Mashinaga benzin quyish uchun zapravkada to‘xtadik.

definition_en: To become bent or twisted out of shape, often because of heat or moisture.
example_en: The wooden door began to warp after the heavy rain and humidity.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg‘ir va namlikdan keyin yog‘och eshik qiyshayib qoldi.

definition_en: Quiet, unclear speech usually showing that someone is unhappy or complaining about something.
example_en: I could hear the angry muttering of the students in the back row.
example_uz: Orqa qatordagi talabalarning jahldor g‘o‘ldirashlarini eshita oldim.

definition_en: Past tense of shake; to move something quickly up and down or side to side.
example_en: He shook the bottle well before pouring the juice into the glass.
example_uz: Sharbatni stakanga quyishdan oldin u idishni yaxshilab silkitdi.

definition_en: A farm animal that produces pork, often used as a dirty or insulting word.
example_en: The farmer decided to raise swine to sell at the local market.
example_uz: Fermer mahalliy bozorda sotish uchun cho'chqa boqishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A short and catchy song used in commercials to help people remember a product.
example_en: That catchy jingle has been stuck in my head all day today.
example_uz: O'sha yopishqoq taronani butun kun davomida kalla-u xayolimdan chiqara olmadim.

definition_en: A formal title used when speaking to a high-ranking man such as a judge.
example_en: May I address your lordship regarding the new evidence in this court case?
example_uz: Sud ishi bo'yicha yangi dalillar yuzasidan janob sudya bilan gaplashsam maylimi?

definition_en: A soft, round, sweet fruit with yellow-orange skin and a large stone inside.
example_en: I love eating a ripe peach on a hot summer afternoon.
example_uz: Yozning issiq tushida pishgan shaftoli yeyishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

definition_en: Close to the side of something or someone.
example_en: The new hospital was built alongside the existing medical center.
example_uz: Yangi kasalxona mavjud tibbiyot markazi yonida qurildi.

definition_en: A person who is very interested in computers or technical topics.
example_en: He is a computer nerd who spends all his time coding.
example_uz: U bor vaqtini dasturlashga sarflaydigan kompyuter ishqibozi.

definition_en: To bend your finger or arm into a curved shape.
example_en: He had to crook his finger to hook it around the ring.
example_uz: U halqani ilib olish uchun barmog'ini bukib qo'ydi.

definition_en: A light coat that protects the wearer from rain.
example_en: I put on my mack before walking out into the heavy rain.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'irda ko'chaga chiqishdan oldin yomg'irpo'shimni kiydim.

definition_en: To understand a complicated idea or concept clearly.
example_en: I find it difficult to grasp the rules of this new game.
example_uz: Ushbu yangi o'yin qoidalarini tushunish menga qiyin bo'lyapti.

definition_en: Making someone feel ashamed, embarrassed, or less important.
example_en: It was a humiliating experience to fail the test in front of everyone.
example_uz: Hamma oldida imtihondan yiqilish juda sharmandali holat edi.

definition_en: An angry argument or disagreement between people.
example_en: They had a minor quarrel about who should wash the dishes.
example_uz: Idishlarni kim yuvishi kerakligi haqida ular biroz tortishib qolishdi.

definition_en: Full of energy, excitement, or activity.
example_en: The party was very lively with music and dancing all night.
example_uz: Kechasi bilan musiqa va raqslar bilan bazm juda jonli o'tdi.

definition_en: A state of feeling or acting with very strong, uncontrolled anger.
example_en: The storm hit the coast with the full fury of the ocean.
example_uz: To'fon qirg'oqqa okeanning butun shiddati bilan yopirildi.

definition_en: Men who are members of the police force.
example_en: The two policemen walked down the street to check the shops.
example_uz: Ikki politsiyachi do'konlarni tekshirish uchun ko'cha bo'ylab yurib ketdi.

definition_en: A teacher or master of a martial art, especially in Japanese styles.
example_en: The sensei taught his students how to focus during the fight.
example_uz: Ustoz o'z shogirdlariga jang paytida qanday diqqatni jamlashni o'rgatdi.

definition_en: Belonging to an early stage of human history or very simple and basic.
example_en: The tribe lived in a primitive hut made of mud and wood.
example_uz: Qabila loy va yog'ochdan yasalgan ibtidoiy kulbada yashardi.

definition_en: The period of time during which a king or queen rules a country.
example_en: Many changes occurred during the queen's long reign over the country.
example_uz: Qirolichaning mamlakatdagi uzoq hukmronlik davrida ko'plab o'zgarishlar yuz berdi.

definition_en: To store or hide something in a safe place for future use.
example_en: She decided to stash her extra cash inside a hollow book.
example_uz: U ortiqcha pulini kovak kitob ichiga yashirib qo'yishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Something that is strange, odd, or not what you usually expect.
example_en: The sky had a peculiar appearance just before the heavy rain started.
example_uz: Katta yomg'ir boshlanishidan oldin osmon juda g'alati tusga kirdi.

definition_en: People who come from a country that is not your own.
example_en: Many foreigners visit our city to see the historical ancient monuments.
example_uz: Ko'plab chet elliklar qadimiy yodgorliklarni ko'rish uchun shahrimizga tashrif buyurishadi.

definition_en: To join two or more things together by melting them.
example_en: The heat was high enough to fuse the different metal pieces together.
example_uz: Issiqlik turli metall parchalarini eritib birlashtirish uchun yetarli edi.

definition_en: A machine used to store food at very cold temperatures to keep it frozen.
example_en: Please put the bag of frozen peas into the freezer right away.
example_uz: Iltimos, muzlatilgan no'xat solingan xaltani tezroq muzlatgichga qo'yib qo'y.

definition_en: Money or property that you receive from someone after they have died.
example_en: She decided to use her inheritance to open a small local bakery.
example_uz: U o'z merosidan foydalanib, kichik mahalliy novvoyxona ochishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A rude way to describe something that you believe is completely untrue or nonsense.
example_en: Don't listen to his story; it is a total load of bollocks.
example_uz: Uning gapiga quloq solma, bularning hammasi safsata.

definition_en: Moved a broom or brush across a floor to clean it.
example_en: She swept the dusty floor until it looked clean and shiny.
example_uz: U chang bosgan yerni toza va yaltiroq bo'lguncha supurdi.

definition_en: A tool with a handle used for moving earth, snow, or other materials.
example_en: He used a large shovel to clear the snow from the driveway.
example_uz: U yo'lakdagi qorni tozalash uchun katta belkurakdan foydalandi.

definition_en: Not judged or understood correctly by other people.
example_en: He is a misunderstood person who actually has a very kind heart.
example_uz: U aslida juda mehribon qalbli, ammo ko'pchilik uni noto'g'ri tushunadi.

definition_en: A physical feeling or awareness that comes when something touches your body.
example_en: I had a strange sensation of being watched by someone nearby.
example_uz: Meni kimdir kuzatayotgandek g'alati bir tuyg'u sezdim.

definition_en: A person who is running away from the law or the police to avoid arrest.
example_en: The police finally caught the fugitive after he hid for two weeks.
example_uz: Politsiya ikki hafta yashiringan qochqinni nihoyat qo'lga oldi.

definition_en: Kept in order and arranged neatly without any mess.
example_en: She always kept her desk immaculately tidy; nothing was ever out of place.
example_uz: U ish stolini doim juda ozoda saqlardi; hamma narsa o'z joyida edi.

definition_en: Unable to move or open because something is stuck or crowded.
example_en: The main road into the city was completely jammed with morning traffic.
example_uz: Shaharga kiradigan asosiy yo‘l ertalabki tirbandlik tufayli butunlay to‘silib qolgan edi.

definition_en: Very stylish, elegant, and of high quality.
example_en: She looked very classy in her new black evening dress today.
example_uz: U bugun yangi qora kechki libosida juda nafis ko‘rinardi.

definition_en: Fungi that grow in the ground or on decaying wood and are often eaten.
example_en: We went to the forest to pick mushrooms for our dinner.
example_uz: Kechki ovqat uchun qo'ziqorin terishga o'rmonga bordik.

definition_en: A person who has at least one million dollars or other currency in total wealth.
example_en: The self-made millionaire donated a large amount of money to the hospital.
example_uz: O'z mehnati bilan boyigan millioner shifoxonaga katta miqdorda pul xayriya qildi.

definition_en: Relating to the universe and the stars, planets, and galaxies within it.
example_en: Scientists are studying cosmic rays to learn more about the early universe.
example_uz: Olimlar koinotning ilk davrini o'rganish uchun kosmik nurlarni tadqiq qilmoqdalar.

definition_en: To bring food or liquid up from your stomach and out through your mouth.
example_en: The spoiled milk made the little boy vomit all night long.
example_uz: Achiq sut sababli kichkina bola tuni bilan qayt qilib chiqdi.

definition_en: A pleasant feeling of being warm or a friendly and kind attitude.
example_en: I love the warmth of the sun on my face in spring.
example_uz: Bahorda yuzimga uriladigan quyosh nurlarining iliqligini yaxshi ko'raman.

definition_en: A word used to express that you are feeling sad or disappointed about something.
example_en: I wanted to go out, but alas, it started raining heavily.
example_uz: Tashqariga chiqmoqchi edim, lekin afsuski, qattiq yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

definition_en: Very strong or great so that it is hard to deal with or resist.
example_en: She felt an overwhelming need to tell the truth to everyone.
example_uz: U hamma narsani rostini aytib qo'yish kerak degan juda kuchli istakni his qildi.

definition_en: A type of strong alcoholic drink that is made from white grapes.
example_en: Would you like a glass of sherry before we eat dinner?
example_uz: Kechki ovqatdan oldin bir stakan sherri ichishni xohlaysizmi?

definition_en: Taking property from a person or place illegally by using force or threats.
example_en: The man was caught while robbing the small shop on the corner.
example_uz: Haligi odam burchakdagi kichik do'konni o'g'irlayotganida qo'lga tushdi.

definition_en: Public honor and fame that someone receives after a great achievement.
example_en: After winning the gold medal, she decided to rest on her laurels.
example_uz: Oltin medalni qo'lga kiritgach u erishgan yutuqlari bilan kifoyalanib qolishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To move slowly especially when pushed by water or air currents.
example_en: The small wooden boat began to drift slowly out to the sea.
example_uz: Kichkina yog'och qayiq asta-sekin dengiz tomon oqib keta boshladi.

definition_en: Having no pity or care for other people's feelings when achieving something.
example_en: The businessman was known for his ruthless approach to removing his competitors.
example_uz: Tadbirkor raqobatchilarini yo'q qilishdagi shafqatsiz yondashuvi bilan tanilgan edi.

definition_en: Of very poor quality or unpleasant.
example_en: I had a really crappy day at work because of the stress.
example_uz: Ishdagi stress tufayli kunim juda yomon o'tdi.

definition_en: Making you feel very sad and without hope.
example_en: Watching the depressing news on television makes me feel very sad.
example_uz: Televizorda qayg'uli xabarlarni ko'rish odamni tushkunlikka soladi.
